name: KTabs
summary: Underline tabs for sections of one object: KLinkTabs when each is an address (aria-current="page"), KTabs inside one page (role=tablist, arrow keys).

label.description: What the tabs are of, for assistive tech.

items.description: A structured value: see the component's TypeScript type.

notes: Arrow keys move between in-page tabs; link tabs are ordinary links.

do: Use for the sections of one thing (Plan, Activity, Attempts).
dont: Never use for filters; that is KSeg.
